presets.exam_text: Matters regarding final exam schedules, admit cards, and grade sheet re-evaluation belong to the Controller of Examinations Office. Forwarded accordingly.
presets.ict_text: Campus optical backbone, campus WiFi, student ERP portal, and smart card biometric issues are managed by ICT & System Services. Forwarded to ICT.
presets.hostel_text: Dormitory room allocation, dining, sanitation, and residential discipline are governed by the Provost and Hall Management (SDZHH). Forwarded accordingly.
